ability.rites_and_paths.ammo_conservatio: Each bow or crossbow shot has a chance not to consume ammo.
ability.rites_and_paths.angelic_form.des: For a few seconds you fly (no sprinting in the air). On activation your negative effects and those of nearby allies are purged, and all of you get Regeneration II and Absorption I while it lasts. You take no fall damage when it ends.
ability.rites_and_paths.berserker_rage.d: For a few seconds you attack faster and harder, but also take more damage. Activating it weakens nearby enemies.
ability.rites_and_paths.bewitch.desc: When Forced Dance or Dissonance ends, normal mobs stay charmed for a few seconds: they don't attack you and fight each other instead. Bosses are immune.
ability.rites_and_paths.bewitch.name: Bewitch
ability.rites_and_paths.bloodthirst.desc: Every time you kill an enemy you recover part of your maximum health.
ability.rites_and_paths.bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
ability.rites_and_paths.bulwark.desc: For a few seconds you greatly reduce all damage you take.
ability.rites_and_paths.bulwark.name: Bulwark
ability.rites_and_paths.charge.desc: You charge in a straight line and crash into the first enemy: it takes low damage, is knocked back and stunned, and you rebound.
ability.rites_and_paths.charge.name: Charge
ability.rites_and_paths.charging_bulwark: During Bulwark you run non-stop at great speed, leaving a wind trail, and damage and knock back anything you trample. You smash through weak blocks (leaves, glass, doors, fences and wooden trapdoors...), but each one hurts you a little depending on its hardness.
ability.rites_and_paths.counterpoint.des: Each time your combo crosses 10, 20 or 30, all your spells on cooldown lose half of their remaining cooldown.
ability.rites_and_paths.crescendo.desc: For a few seconds misses don't lower your combo and every hit counts double.
ability.rites_and_paths.crescendo.name: Crescendo
ability.rites_and_paths.decoy.desc: When you turn invisible you leave behind a clone with your gear that draws in enemies and runs away.
ability.rites_and_paths.decoy.name: Decoy
ability.rites_and_paths.deflect.desc: Automatic, with a cooldown. Reduces a projectile's damage by an amount equal to your Total Level. If you reduce it to zero, you send it back. Grants charges: +1 in Fire, +3 in Water and +1 in Stone.
ability.rites_and_paths.deflect.name: Projectile Deflection
ability.rites_and_paths.double_jump.desc: Press jump again in mid-air to perform a second jump.
ability.rites_and_paths.double_jump.name: Double Jump
ability.rites_and_paths.free_cast_slot_1: Choose a spell (select it on the wheel and use /clase conjuro 1) that stays bound to this slot for good. While you have charges, casting it costs a charge instead of mana.
ability.rites_and_paths.free_cast_slot_2: Second free-cast slot, with more charges and a higher cost limit.
ability.rites_and_paths.free_cast_slot_3: Third free-cast slot, with the highest allowed cost.
ability.rites_and_paths.harmony.desc: If you play perfectly (every note and no extra presses), each cycle of bursts raises one stage and your auras grow stronger. A miss or an extra press drops two stages.
ability.rites_and_paths.harmony.name: Harmony
ability.rites_and_paths.healer_eye.desc: You see the health of nearby allies above their heads (even through walls). Those below 40% glow, and allies downed by Miracle show their countdown. Only you can see it.
ability.rites_and_paths.healer_eye.name: Healer's Eye
While Bulwark is active, part of the damage you mitigate heals nearby allies and yourself.
ability.rites_and_paths.heavy_shot.desc: Holding the bow fully drawn increases shot damage in time steps.
ability.rites_and_paths.heavy_shot.name: Heavy Shot
ability.rites_and_paths.incorruptible_bu: Bulwark removes all your negative effects and makes you immune to new ones while it lasts.
You heal the ally you are looking at (nearby) for 30% of their maximum health, without spending mana. Scales with your holy power. Lifts a downed ally.
ability.rites_and_paths.lethal_shot.desc: Upgrades Heavy Shot: the steps come sooner and the last one is much stronger.
ability.rites_and_paths.lethal_shot.name: Lethal Shot
ability.rites_and_paths.light_step.desc: You take no fall damage and walk on water. In Fire Stance you also walk on lava.
ability.rites_and_paths.light_step.name: Light Step
ability.rites_and_paths.miracle.desc: If an ally (pets too) was about to die near you, they are downed for a few seconds instead: they cannot act or take damage. If another player heals them, they get back up; if not, they die. Each ally can only be saved this way every so often. It does not save you.
ability.rites_and_paths.miracle.name: Miracle
ability.rites_and_paths.prayer.desc: Pick an ally from the list: your body stays kneeling and your camera moves to a small angel that orbits your ally and gives them Regeneration. Your spells, Laying on Hands and Sanctuary come from the angel; spells lose power if your body is far away. Press again to switch ally or stop praying.
ability.rites_and_paths.prayer.name: Prayer
ability.rites_and_paths.recital.desc: After casting three different spells from your instrument in a short time, the next one costs no mana and loses half of its cooldown (with a minimum time between uses).
ability.rites_and_paths.recital.name: Recital
ability.rites_and_paths.rhythm.desc: With an instrument in hand you play a rhythm minigame: each note asks for left click, right click, Shift or Space, and the action really happens. Only failing to press the requested lane in time is a miss (pressing other lanes isn't punished). Each hit raises your combo, gives musical power and speeds up the tempo; a miss costs you half your combo. Notes come in bursts with rests between them. A left click on the beat deals extra damage. Each musical spell needs a minimum combo to be cast.
ability.rites_and_paths.rhythm.name: Rhythm
ability.rites_and_paths.rhythmic_fury.de: With Harmony at stage 3 or higher, you deal more melee damage.
ability.rites_and_paths.sacrifice.desc: You pay part of your maximum health and the ally you are looking at recovers part of theirs (at least what you paid). No cooldown. If paying would kill you, the icon turns red: press twice to give your life; your ally recovers all their missing health, gains as many golden hearts as the health they had and is invulnerable for a moment. Its healing is true healing: nothing can increase or reduce it.
ability.rites_and_paths.sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
ability.rites_and_paths.sanctuary.desc: Hold the key: a holy sphere surrounds you, pushes enemies out and blocks their projectiles (except piercing ones). It blocks area damage (explosions, spells and clouds) to anyone inside, taking it on the shield alone, and takes the blows of enemies that touch it; it cracks as it weakens and eventually breaks. It costs mana every second; when released it lasts half as long as you held it. While holding it you move slower and cannot cast spells.
ability.rites_and_paths.sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
ability.rites_and_paths.shadow_step.desc: You teleport behind the enemy you are looking at (up to 10 blocks). For 8 s your hits against that enemy are guaranteed critical hits and, if you kill it in that time, the ability recharges instantly.
ability.rites_and_paths.shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
ability.rites_and_paths.stances.desc: Each press switches to the next stance (Water, Stone, Fire). You only build charges of the active stance: Fire with every unarmed hit (more damage), Stone when taking hits (more armor) and Water when running, dodging or deflecting (more speed and jump). At maximum, or with Shift + hit (or crouch + this key) from 10 charges, your next unarmed hit spends them all: Fiery Strike, stun or Countercurrent. Switching stance releases the previous stance's charges as an area effect. Charges fade gradually when you stop gaining them and when you put on armor.
ability.rites_and_paths.stances.name: Elemental Stances
ability.rites_and_paths.steady_guard.des: You deal more damage to enemies that are targeting you.
ability.rites_and_paths.stealth.desc: When you crouch you become truly invisible while you have Stealth bar left. Attacking or casting a spell uses up a large part of the bar.
ability.rites_and_paths.stealth.name: Stealth
ability.rites_and_paths.taunt.desc: Forces nearby mobs to attack you, slows them and reduces the damage you take for a few seconds.
ability.rites_and_paths.taunt.name: Taunt
ability.rites_and_paths.time_rewind.desc: You return to where you were a few seconds ago and recover part of the health and mana you have lost since then (it never takes any away). It cancels fall damage; with higher subclass levels the window is longer, you recover more, negative effects received in that time are removed and the spells you cast in it get part of their cooldown back. Changing dimension, dying or teleporting far away clears the history.
ability.rites_and_paths.time_rewind.name: Time Rewind
ability.rites_and_paths.time_stop.desc: You create a sphere of stopped time around you. Everything inside it, and anything that enters while it lasts (projectiles included), is frozen; you and your allies are not. Bosses are only frozen for part of the time. The sphere looks grey from inside and outside; frozen players see everything in grey, switch to third person and hear a ticking clock until it ends. Costs mana.
ability.rites_and_paths.time_stop.name: Time Stop
ability.rites_and_paths.triple_jump.desc: Adds a third jump in mid-air.
ability.rites_and_paths.triple_jump.name: Triple Jump
ability.rites_and_paths.wall_climb.desc: Crouching next to a wall you cling to it and can climb it. If you draw a bow, you let go.
ability.rites_and_paths.wall_climb.name: Wall Climb
ability.rites_and_paths.wind_dash.desc: A horizontal burst in mid-air, with charges that recover on their own.
ability.rites_and_paths.wind_dash.name: Wind Dash
branch.rites_and_paths.barbarian.brutali: Your critical hits deal much more damage.
branch.rites_and_paths.barbarian.fury.de: Wound Fury: you deal more damage the more health you are missing.
branch.rites_and_paths.barbarian.hardene: You take less damage from falls, fire and explosions, and lose less hunger.
branch.rites_and_paths.barbarian.iron_sk: With no armor on, you gain armor, toughness and movement speed.
branch.rites_and_paths.barbarian.stamped: Charge reaches farther and recharges sooner. Dormant until you have Charge.
branch.rites_and_paths.bard.compas.desc: Increases the power of the musical school.
branch.rites_and_paths.bard.compas.name: Measure
branch.rites_and_paths.bard.dance.desc: Playing no longer slows you down, and you run faster while one of your songs is playing (counts toward the speed cap).
branch.rites_and_paths.bard.dance.name: Dance
branch.rites_and_paths.bard.perfect_pitc: A wider hit window and, with more points, a miss costs you less combo (down to just a quarter).
branch.rites_and_paths.bard.resonance.de: Increases the radius of your auras.
branch.rites_and_paths.bard.reverberatio: Your aura effects keep going for a few seconds after leaving them or after the song ends.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.aegis.desc: Part of the excess healing (above maximum health) turns into absorption for a few seconds.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.aegis.name: Aegis
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.blessing.d: The beneficial effects you give with your spells last longer. Does not affect class abilities.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.divine_res: More maximum mana and more mana regeneration.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.healing.de: Your spells heal more and give more absorption (also those you cast on yourself). Does not affect class abilities.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.purificati: Your heals shorten the negative effects on whoever you heal.
branch.rites_and_paths.mage.cadence.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your spells.
branch.rites_and_paths.mage.cadence.name: Cadence
branch.rites_and_paths.mage.fluidity.des: You move faster; with the branch full, casting spells does not slow you down.
branch.rites_and_paths.mage.power.desc: Increases the power of all your spells.
branch.rites_and_paths.mage.power.name: Power
branch.rites_and_paths.mage.reserve.desc: Increases your maximum mana and how fast you recover it (+40% mana per second at 10 points). Iron's regenerates based on maximum mana, so the regeneration attribute is lowered to compensate.
branch.rites_and_paths.mage.reserve.name: Reserve
branch.rites_and_paths.mage.summoning.de: Your summons have more health and deal more damage.
branch.rites_and_paths.monk.fist.desc: Empowers Fire charges: more damage per charge and a stronger discharge wave.
branch.rites_and_paths.monk.fist.name: Fist
branch.rites_and_paths.monk.meditation.d: Crouching and standing still for a few seconds, you slowly heal up to a health limit. Taking damage interrupts it. When you stop meditating you gain 4 charges of your stance that do not decay for 10 s.
branch.rites_and_paths.monk.skin.desc: Empowers Stone charges: more armor and toughness per charge and more absorption on discharge.
branch.rites_and_paths.monk.skin.name: Skin
branch.rites_and_paths.monk.stance_maste: Your discharges when switching stance and your own stance effects are stronger: +20% at 5 points and +40% at 10 (maximum charges remain 10).
branch.rites_and_paths.monk.wind.desc: Empowers Water charges: more speed and jump per charge and a stronger discharge.
branch.rites_and_paths.monk.wind.name: Wind
branch.rites_and_paths.paladin.banner.de: An aura around you: you and your allies gain armor and negative effects last shorter on you. Does not stack with another Paladin's.
branch.rites_and_paths.paladin.cuirass.d: Multiplies the armor and toughness granted by the pieces you are wearing.
branch.rites_and_paths.paladin.push.desc: You get pushed less and you push enemies more.
branch.rites_and_paths.paladin.push.name: Push
branch.rites_and_paths.paladin.smite.des: More damage against undead and Nether mobs, and slightly more damage overall if you carry no shield.
branch.rites_and_paths.paladin.will.desc: Negative effects last shorter on you.
branch.rites_and_paths.paladin.will.name: Will
branch.rites_and_paths.ranger.aim.desc: More damage with bows and crossbows, and zoom when crouching with the bow in hand or while drawing it.
branch.rites_and_paths.ranger.aim.name: Aim
branch.rites_and_paths.ranger.range.desc: Your projectiles fly faster and travel farther. Does not increase damage.
branch.rites_and_paths.ranger.range.name: Range
branch.rites_and_paths.ranger.retreat.de: With the branch full, after taking a melee hit you run faster for a few seconds.
branch.rites_and_paths.ranger.special_ar: The effects of your potion arrows last longer and are stronger.
Epic Fight's dodge uses less stamina and its invulnerability lasts longer.
branch.rites_and_paths.rogue.edge.desc: You attack faster and your critical hits deal more damage.
branch.rites_and_paths.rogue.edge.name: Edge
branch.rites_and_paths.rogue.shadow.desc: Mobs detect you from closer, and your critical hits from invisibility deal more damage.
branch.rites_and_paths.rogue.shadow.name: Shadow
branch.rites_and_paths.rogue.toxins.desc: Your hits can poison with Toxin, a slow damage that does not stack.
branch.rites_and_paths.rogue.toxins.name: Toxins
branch.rites_and_paths.rogue.wind.name: Wind
class.rites_and_paths.barbarian.desc: An unarmored warrior with heavy weapons. The less health he has, the more damage he deals, and his critical hits are the strongest. Wearing any piece of armor switches off his natural defense, except Barbarian harnesses (his class gear).
class.rites_and_paths.barbarian.name: Barbarian
class.rites_and_paths.bard.desc: Half mage, half fighter, who fights while playing: with an instrument in hand they play a rhythm minigame with left click, right click, Shift and Space (each lane still does its usual action). Hitting notes raises the combo, which powers the musical school, exclusive to the Bard. Their spells are sheet music stored in the instrument (off hand) and cast with right click: most of them are auras for their allies.
class.rites_and_paths.bard.name: Bard
class.rites_and_paths.bard.trait: Class trait: slightly less max health.
class.rites_and_paths.cleric.desc: Holy healer: a kind of healing mage who shares the holy school with the Paladin. Their holy magic has no wall and every other school loses 35%. Very weak with weapons, armor and shields. Heals, extends buffs, purifies, protects with shields of light and saves allies from the final blow.
class.rites_and_paths.cleric.name: Cleric
class.rites_and_paths.cleric.trait: Class trait: slightly higher maximum health.
class.rites_and_paths.mage.desc: Spellcaster using Iron's Spells. Lots of ranged damage and utility in exchange for very little toughness. Its branches increase spell power, mana and cooldown speed.
class.rites_and_paths.mage.name: Mage
class.rites_and_paths.monk.desc: An unarmed, unarmored fighter. Their level gives a base of damage and defense; the rest is earned in combat by building Fire, Stone or Water charges. Wearing armor switches off their passives and wipes the charges, except Monk robes (their class gear). Nunchaku, sai, bo and knuckles count as unarmed.
class.rites_and_paths.monk.name: Monk
class.rites_and_paths.monk.trait: Martial Body: no armor (Monk robes do not count), unarmed damage, armor and toughness that grow with your base class points (full at 30). Fire subtracts 25% from this armor and Water 25% from this damage.
class.rites_and_paths.paladin.desc: The group's tank. Withstands more than anyone with armor and shield, draws enemies in and protects allies. Deals little damage on his own.
class.rites_and_paths.paladin.name: Paladin
class.rites_and_paths.paladin.trait: Class trait: more maximum health and slightly less speed.
class.rites_and_paths.ranger.desc: Bow marksman. Steady ranged damage, fast long-range arrows and good mobility. Can wear armor without penalty.
class.rites_and_paths.ranger.name: Ranger
class.rites_and_paths.rogue.desc: An agile assassin with light weapons. Turns invisible, strikes by surprise with guaranteed critical hits and moves very fast. Very fragile if caught.
class.rites_and_paths.rogue.name: Rogue
curio.rites_and_paths.arcane_hourglass.d: When you drop below 30% health, projectiles within 6 blocks slow down (60 s).
curio.rites_and_paths.archmage_prism.des: Every 5th damaging spell refracts: 30% of it jumps to another nearby enemy.
curio.rites_and_paths.crow_cloak.desc: When you leave invisibility, a flock of crows blinds enemies within 3 blocks for 1 s (15 s).
curio.rites_and_paths.cyclops_horn.desc: When you enter combat the horn sounds: enemies within 16 blocks glow for 8 s and your allies gain Strength for 8 s (90 s).
curio.rites_and_paths.dragonslayer_quive: Every 11th arrow is a dragon bone arrow: +50% damage and pierces one enemy.
curio.rites_and_paths.evergreen_leaf.des: Inside leaves you regenerate health and mobs farther than 8 blocks do not target you.
curio.rites_and_paths.fang_collar.desc: Each hostile mob you kill adds a fang (max 10, lost on death): +1% melee damage per fang.
curio.rites_and_paths.frost_ring.desc: You freeze water as you walk on it.
curio.rites_and_paths.gorgon_eye.desc: Staring for 2 s at a non-boss mob petrifies it for 2 s (30 s).
curio.rites_and_paths.guild_insignia.des: When you switch to a weapon of another discipline, +10% melee damage for 3 s (6 s).
curio.rites_and_paths.hermit_medallion.d: Attracts items and experience orbs within 6 blocks.
curio.rites_and_paths.hippogryph_feather: Drawing a bow in mid-air makes you glide.
curio.rites_and_paths.last_breath_compas: When you die, a column of light marks the place where you fell for 10 min.
curio.rites_and_paths.loaded_dice.desc: Each critical hit rolls a die: on a 6 it deals an extra ×1.5; on a 1 it becomes a normal hit.
curio.rites_and_paths.magma_heart.desc: When you take a melee hit, 15% chance to set the attacker on fire. You leave glowing footprints.
curio.rites_and_paths.midnight_veil.desc: The sun deals half damage to you.
curio.rites_and_paths.oath_reliquary.des: Whoever hits a mob that is chasing you (you or your allies) heals 1 HP (once per second).
curio.rites_and_paths.phoenix_feather.de: A lethal hit makes you be reborn in flames with 30% health (20 min). Resolves after class and race abilities.
curio.rites_and_paths.pixie_bell.desc: Crouching in mid-air, you float for 3 s (10 s cooldown).
curio.rites_and_paths.pocket_banner.desc: You carry a golden banner on your back.
curio.rites_and_paths.relic_rule: You can only wear one Relic at a time.
curio.rites_and_paths.serpent_pendant.de: You swim faster and, when leaving the water, run faster for 5 s.
curio.rites_and_paths.stance_rosary.desc: When switching stance with 8 or more charges, the beads bounce between 3 enemies.
curio.rites_and_paths.storm_talisman.des: When you take a melee hit, 10% chance for lightning to strike the attacker (8 s).
curio.rites_and_paths.temple_bell.desc: When you finish meditating, your allies within 8 blocks lose one negative effect.
curio.rites_and_paths.tide_conch.desc: Underwater, your allies within 5 blocks recover air. On land, if you are burning, it puts the fire out (10 s).
curio.rites_and_paths.traveler_belt.desc: Below 6 hunger shanks you eat only food from your inventory (no effects).
curio.rites_and_paths.trinket_pouch.desc: 5% chance to duplicate a common drop on kill.
curio.rites_and_paths.troll_earring.desc: When your Last Stand activates, mobs within 6 blocks flee.
curio.rites_and_paths.trophy_skull.desc: When you kill a boss, the skull keeps its trophy and grants you a trait of that boss until the next one (fire immunity, slowness immunity, wither immunity... or +10% damage).
curio.rites_and_paths.trophy_skull.taken: The skull holds the trophy of %s
curio.rites_and_paths.war_drum.desc: Berserker Rage sounds the drums: your allies within 10 blocks attack faster for 10 s.
curio.rites_and_paths.wisp_lantern.desc: Every 30 s, a will-o'-the-wisp flies toward the nearest chest or spawner within 24 blocks.

death.attack.rites_and_paths.martyrdom: %1$s gave their life for their allies

death.attack.rites_and_paths.toxin.playe: %1$s died poisoned by a toxin while fleeing from %2$s

discipline.rites_and_paths.bow.name: Bow
discipline.rites_and_paths.heavy.name: Heavy Weapons
discipline.rites_and_paths.light.name: Light Weapons

gear.rites_and_paths.element.fire: Fire scales: each piece reduces fire damage.
gear.rites_and_paths.element.ice: Ice scales: each piece reduces ice damage.
gear.rites_and_paths.element.lightning: Lightning scales: each piece reduces lightning damage.
gear.rites_and_paths.exempt.barbarian: Does not disable the Barbarian's unarmed passives.
gear.rites_and_paths.exempt.monk: Does not disable Martial Body or wipe the Monk's charges.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.barbarian_chain: War Rattle: the first hit after 2 s of running knocks back harder.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.barbarian_diamo: Crunch: your critical hits slow the target for 1 s (once every 3 s per target).
gear.rites_and_paths.set.barbarian_drago: Dragon's Roar: Berserker Rage lets out a roar; non-boss mobs within 8 blocks flee and suffer the scales' element.
Wyrm's Wrath: below 40% health or during Berserker Rage you sprout spectral wings and each critical hit releases a 4-block elemental cone (once per second).
Golden Loot: when you kill a hostile mob, 10% chance it drops a gold nugget that leaps toward you.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.barbarian_leath: Scent: hostile mobs within 12 blocks with less than 30% health glow.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.barbarian_nethe: Ember Heart: each hit you take builds an ember (max 5, 8 s). Charge or Berserker Rage releases them in a 4-block ring of fire.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_chain.desc: Ringing Links: each charge chimes and, on reaching the threshold, the links ring in chord.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_chain.name: Ringed Gi
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_diamond.de: Crystal Reflection: Projectile Deflection grants +1 charge with a prismatic flash.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_dragon.des: Dragon Dance: when you trigger a stance effect, a spectral dragon in the stance's color circles you for 4 s and bites the nearest enemy every second.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_dragonstee: Wyrm Fist: each stance effect launches an energy dragon head that travels 8 blocks in a line. Fire: walking on lava in Fire Stance grants speed. Ice: in Water you freeze water as you walk. Lightning: in Stone, heavy hits you take release a spark.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_gold.name: Pilgrim's Tunic
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_iron.desc: Firm Stance: Stone gains charge from hits as low as 1.5 HP.
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_iron.name: Iron Gi
gear.rites_and_paths.set.monk_leather.de: First Step: when entering a stance with no charges you receive 1, and charges decay 10% slower.
Stance Seal: Stone charges decay half as fast and, when switching stance with 5 or more charges, you leave a runic seal that repeats the discharge at 30% after 3 s.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.bo.desc: Slow, with extra reach and an arc sweep that hits other enemies for 60%.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.bo.late1: Ashen Sweep: the sweep blinds mobs for 1 s.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.bo.late2: Pole Vault: crouch + jump launches you forward and you land with a shockwave (8 s).
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.bo.late3: Horizon Wave: if you wait 1.5 s between hits, the hit sends out an elemental wave in an arc.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.element.ligh: Lightning: each hit jumps to a nearby enemy.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.knuckles.des: Worn in the Curios hands slot (or in the off hand), they improve empty-handed strikes.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.knuckles.lat: Obsidian Fists: on the 5th hit against the same target, a 2-block burst.
Dragon Claws: your hits can inflict Wound (−30% healing for 4 s).
Wyrm Fists: your hits apply the element and the Monk's stance effects are 20% stronger.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.monk: Monk: counts as unarmed (charges, perks and subclass).
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.nunchaku.des: Fast, with short reach. For the Monk it counts as unarmed.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.nunchaku.lat: Whirl: every 8 chained hits, a spin that strikes all around for 50%.
Bone Echo: the Whirl leaves a ghost nunchaku that repeats 3 hits at 30%.
Chain Storm: the Whirl becomes a 3 s whirlwind that pulls enemies in and applies the element.
gear.rites_and_paths.weapon.sai.desc: Medium speed. Hold right click to guard: a hit in the first instants is parried and stuns the attacker; otherwise it reduces damage.

perk.rites_and_paths.monk.meditation.cle: While meditating you purge a negative effect every 5 s.
perk.rites_and_paths.monk.meditation.dee: You heal twice as fast while meditating and up to 80% of your health, but take longer to start.
perk.rites_and_paths.monk.skin.spirit_sk: Less armor and toughness, but you take much less magic and elemental damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.monk.skin.stone_ech: The absorption of the Stone discharge is doubled, but you only gain Stone charges from hits dealing 4 or more damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.monk.stance_mastery: When switching stance you keep 30% of the charges in the new one and only discharge the rest. You switch stance 1 s slower.
Crouch + the stances key sets your favorite stance: its discharge and stance effect are 30% stronger, and those of the other two are 30% weaker.
perk.rites_and_paths.monk.wind.light_fee: You ignore cobwebs, soul sand, honey, powder snow and the slowdown from eating or using items. Slightly less speed.
perk.rites_and_paths.monk.wind.running_m: After running for a moment, your next unarmed hit deals more damage and knocks back more.
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.banner.life: Your aura regenerates your allies' health (not yours).
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.banner.war_: Your aura also increases your allies' damage, but you lose armor.
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.cuirass.col: More maximum health, but you are slightly slower.
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.cuirass.hea: Your armor pieces protect even more, but you are slightly slower.
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.push.shield: When you block a melee hit with a shield, you throw the attacker back.
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.push.shockw: Every few hits you release a wave that pushes and damages nearby enemies.
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.smite.conde: You mark your target: it takes more damage from you. You cannot mark another while it lasts.
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.smite.judge: Every few hits you unleash area holy damage, in exchange for less base damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.paladin.will.will_v: Immune to slowness, weakness, blindness, fatigue, nausea and darkness. Other negative effects last longer on you.
Immune to effects that deal damage (poison, wither, burning). Other negative effects last longer on you.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.aim.mobile_s: More damage while moving; less if you stand still.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.aim.steady_s: More damage if you have stood still for a moment; less if you shoot while running or airborne.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.cadence.agil: Drawing the bow does not slow you down, but you draw slightly slower.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.cadence.quic: After taking a melee hit, your next arrow fires with an instant draw and slightly less damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.range.hunter: The impact marks the target: it takes more damage from all sources.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.range.pierci: The arrow pierces one more enemy, with slightly less damage to the first.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.retreat.evas: Every so often, the first melee hit makes you leap backward without taking damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.retreat.hunt: After taking a melee hit you leave a trap that heavily slows whoever steps on it.
perk.rites_and_paths.ranger.special_arro: Normal arrows explode on impact without breaking blocks and knock back nearby enemies, with less direct damage.
The impact slows the target, but your arrows fly slightly slower.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.acrobatics.co: After a successful dodge, your next hit deals more damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.acrobatics.lo: The dodge covers more distance, but its invulnerability lasts less.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.edge.flurry.d: You attack even faster, with slightly less damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.edge.thrust.d: You ignore part of the target's armor, but attack slower.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.shadow.deep_s: Stealth lasts considerably longer, but mobs detect you from farther away.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.shadow.treach: More damage against enemies that are not targeting you. Stealth lasts less.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.toxins.concen: Toxin deals the same damage, but much faster.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.toxins.prolon: Toxin deals the same damage, more slowly, and slows the target while it lasts.
Chance to dodge hits and projectiles by leaping backward. Less maximum health.
perk.rites_and_paths.rogue.wind.lightnes: More movement and attack speed, but Stealth runs out sooner.
race.rites_and_paths.centaur.desc: Horse body: accelerates gradually when running in a straight line and, above 40% of its top speed, rams whatever it hits (losing speed when it does). Charged jump like a horse (hold jump) and an ally can ride on its back. Does not fit through 1-block gaps and cannot ride animals or boats.
race.rites_and_paths.centaur.name: Centaur
race.rites_and_paths.colossus.desc: Twice the size and twice the health (no cap). Breaks blocks in a 2×2×2 cube (one at a time while sneaking), and its reach, step, jump and safe fall grow with its size. In exchange: more hunger, cannot swim (sinks), mobs detect it from farther away, tramples crops and cannot ride animals or boats.
race.rites_and_paths.colossus.name: Colossus
race.rites_and_paths.draconid.desc: Descendant of dragons: resists damage from its element and breathes a breath of that element (racial key 1), which costs mana and suffers your class's Magic wall. Wild dragons of its element (Ice and Fire) do not attack it unless provoked. Uses more hunger.
race.rites_and_paths.draconid.name: Draconid
race.rites_and_paths.dwarf.desc: Short and slow, but a born miner: breaks stone and ores faster and has racial Fortune on ores (it doesn't add to the enchantment: the higher one counts).
race.rites_and_paths.dwarf.name: Dwarf
race.rites_and_paths.elf.desc: Passes through leaves and climbs them like scaffolding (jumping goes up, crouching goes down). Cannot eat meat or fish.
race.rites_and_paths.elf.name: Elf
race.rites_and_paths.goblin.desc: Half the height: very hard to hit and fits through small gaps. Has racial Luck and Looting (the higher of this and the enchantment counts). In return, much less health.
race.rites_and_paths.goblin.name: Goblin
race.rites_and_paths.human.desc: Versatile: eases the drawbacks of their class. After choosing a class they pick a wall, whose penalty is reduced according to Rank; the class's negative base traits are reduced the same way. No environmental perks.
race.rites_and_paths.human.name: Human
race.rites_and_paths.infernal.desc: Immune to fire and lava, but cold and water hurt more and entering water slowly burns them. With Iron's Spells they have racial fire spells always available, which suffer your class's Magic wall like any spell. Iron golems always attack them and villagers charge them more.
race.rites_and_paths.infernal.name: Infernal
race.rites_and_paths.orc.desc: Bigger and tougher. Once per life they survive a lethal hit with half a heart. In return they use more hunger and are easier to hit.
race.rites_and_paths.orc.name: Orc
race.rites_and_paths.slime.desc: Takes no fall damage, bounces when landing on any block (sneaking prevents it) and jumps twice as high. In exchange, less health and it gets knocked back farther.
race.rites_and_paths.slime.name: Slime
race.rites_and_paths.triton.desc: Breathes underwater, swims faster, mines underwater at normal speed and sees in the dark underwater. Fire hurts more and in the Nether they have Weakness.
race.rites_and_paths.triton.name: Triton
race.rites_and_paths.undead.desc: Breathes underwater, their hunger is fixed and they constantly regenerate health (interrupted for a few seconds when taking damage). Direct sunlight damages them even with a helmet, and neither healing potions nor spells heal them.
race.rites_and_paths.undead.name: Undead

rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.pegasus.2.d: Offer 64 feathers, 16 phantom membranes and 8 firework rockets.

rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.pegasus.3.o: Boss defeated up high with 3 glides

rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.unicorn.2.o: Golden apples, amethyst, gold and flowers

rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.unicorn.3.o: Boss defeated with allies in the aura
rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.warrior.1.d: Defeat 30 enemies with melee attacks at no less than 40% of your top speed.
rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.warrior.2.d: Offer a full set of iron armor, 1 iron weapon, 8 leather and 16 iron ingots.
rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.warrior.2.o: Iron armor and weapon, leather and iron
rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.warrior.3.d: Defeat a rite boss chaining at least 10 melee hits without dropping below 40% of your speed.
rite.rites_and_paths.centaur.warrior.3.o: Boss defeated with 10 hits at a gallop

rite.rites_and_paths.colossus.porter.1.o: Enemies defeated with a loaded belt

rite.rites_and_paths.colossus.porter.2.o: Chests, furnaces, table, leather and iron
rite.rites_and_paths.colossus.porter.3.d: Defeat a rite boss with an ally riding on you who deals at least 25% of the damage.

rite.rites_and_paths.colossus.titan.2.de: Offer 4 iron blocks, 8 obsidian, 64 cobblestone and 1 anvil.
rite.rites_and_paths.colossus.titan.3.de: Defeat a rite boss with the Titan form active and deal at least 50% of the damage in that form.

rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.acid.2.des: Offer 4 potions of Harming, 16 spider eyes and 16 slimeballs.
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.acid.2.o0: Harming potions, spider eyes and slime

rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.fire.3.des: With the altar in the Nether, defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with your breath.
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.ice.2.desc: Offer 64 snow blocks, 16 packed ice and 4 blue ice.
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.ice.3.desc: With the altar in a snowy or frozen biome, defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with your breath.
Defeat 30 enemies with your breath (lightning jumps count).
Offer 4 lightning rods, 32 copper ingots and 16 redstone.
Summon a rite boss during a thunderstorm, with the altar under open sky, and defeat it dealing at least 50% of the damage with your breath.
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.poison.1.d: Defeat 30 enemies poisoned by your breath (undead do not count).
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.poison.2.d: Offer 16 spider eyes, 4 potions of Poison, 8 poisonous potatoes and 4 pufferfish.
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.poison.2.o: Spider eyes, poison, potatoes and pufferfish
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.poison.3.d: Defeat a rite boss poisoning it with your breath at least 5 times.
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.water.1.de: Defeat 30 enemies with your breath, 10 of them while you are submerged.
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.water.1.o1: Defeated with the breath while submerged
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.water.2.de: Offer 16 fish of at least 3 kinds, 32 kelp and 8 potions of Water Breathing.
rite.rites_and_paths.draconid.water.3.de: With the altar underwater (at least 3 blocks deep), defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with your breath.
rite.rites_and_paths.dwarf.deep.2.desc: Offer 64 ores of at least 3 types.
rite.rites_and_paths.dwarf.deep.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar underground.
Defeat 20 enemies with your own explosions.
Craft and offer 16 TNT (crafted while doing this rite).
Defeat a rite boss that takes at least 4 of your explosions.
rite.rites_and_paths.dwarf.smith.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with a weapon you crafted.
rite.rites_and_paths.dwarf.smith.2.desc: Offer an iron armor set and an iron weapon crafted by you.
rite.rites_and_paths.dwarf.smith.2.o0: Iron armor and weapon made by you

rite.rites_and_paths.dwarf.smith.3.o0: Boss defeated in your diamond armor

rite.rites_and_paths.elf.arcane.1.o0: Enemies defeated with your enchanted weapon

rite.rites_and_paths.goblin.thief.3.desc: Offer 3 pieces of mob gear (stolen or dropped by mobs you killed) and defeat a rite boss.

rite.rites_and_paths.goblin.trapper.3.de: Defeat a rite boss immobilized by your Snare at least 3 times.

Summon a rite boss and defeat it dealing at least 90% of the damage with your wall's discipline.

rite.rites_and_paths.infernal.native.2.d: Barter 20 times with piglins and offer 16 Nether quartz.
rite.rites_and_paths.infernal.native.3.d: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar in the Nether.
rite.rites_and_paths.infernal.pyromaniac: Defeat 40 enemies with your racial spells.

Defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with racial spells.
Defeat 20 enemies while standing on lava.
Offer 64 ingots of at least 3 types.
Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar within 4 blocks of lava.

rite.rites_and_paths.orc.devourer.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss and offer one of its drops on the altar.

rite.rites_and_paths.orc.warlord.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss with at least 2 allies (players or pets) within 12 blocks.

rite.rites_and_paths.slime.spring.2.desc: Offer 8 pistons, 4 sticky pistons, 16 slimeballs and 4 slime blocks.
rite.rites_and_paths.slime.spring.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss hitting it with at least 3 launch crashes during the fight.

rite.rites_and_paths.slime.swarm.2.desc: Offer 32 slimeballs, 4 slime blocks and 3 potions of Healing.
rite.rites_and_paths.slime.swarm.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss while split, with at least 6 slimes alive at the end and at least 50% of the damage by contact.

rite.rites_and_paths.slime.viscous.2.des: Offer 8 honey blocks, 16 honey bottles, 16 slimeballs and 8 cobwebs.
rite.rites_and_paths.slime.viscous.3.des: Defeat a rite boss having been stuck to it for at least 10 s in total and with at least 20 hits that apply Slowness.

rite.rites_and_paths.triton.abyssal.3.de: Defeat an elder guardian, or a rite boss summoned with the altar underwater.
rite.rites_and_paths.triton.fisher.2.des: Offer 32 fish of 4 types and an enchanted fishing rod.
rite.rites_and_paths.triton.fisher.3.des: Offer a treasure item you fished up and defeat a rite boss.

rite.rites_and_paths.triton.shaper.2.des: Offer 4 sponges, 8 coral blocks and 3 water buckets.
rite.rites_and_paths.triton.shaper.3.des: Defeat a rite boss casting your racial water spells at least 3 times.
rite.rites_and_paths.triton.shaper.3.o0: Boss defeated with 3 racial water spells

rite.rites_and_paths.undead.skeleton.3.d: Defeat a rite boss after taking at least 10 projectiles from it or its escort without dying.
rite.rites_and_paths.undead.specter.1.de: Defeat 20 flying mobs (phantoms, vexes, blazes, ghasts…).
rite.rites_and_paths.undead.specter.2.de: Offer 16 phantom membranes, 16 feathers and 4 ender pearls.
rite.rites_and_paths.undead.specter.3.de: Defeat a rite boss using Ethereal Form at least 3 times during the fight.

rite.rites_and_paths.undead.vampire.2.de: Offer 16 redstone dust, 8 beetroots and 8 red mushrooms.
rite.rites_and_paths.undead.vampire.3.de: Defeat a rite boss recovering at least 100 HP with Thirst during the fight.
rite.rites_and_paths.undead.vampire.3.o0: Boss defeated healing 100 HP with Thirst
spell.rites_and_paths.cutting_note.guide: You fire a sharp note that deals sonic damage. At high levels it pierces enemies.
spell.rites_and_paths.dissonance.guide: A broken note around you: enemies are silenced (no spells) and stunned for a moment.
spell.rites_and_paths.echo.guide: Repeats your last musical spell at half power, without spending that spell's mana or cooldown. Only works if you cast it recently.
spell.rites_and_paths.elegy.guide: Aura: nearby enemies become weak and slow.
spell.rites_and_paths.eternal_lullaby.gu: A lullaby that protects your nearby allies: the first lethal blow each one takes while it lasts doesn't kill them; they survive with part of their health and no negative effects.
spell.rites_and_paths.final_requiem.guid: The grand finale: huge sonic damage around you and more damage for your allies for a few seconds.
spell.rites_and_paths.forced_dance.guide: Your target starts dancing: it can't attack, cast spells or use items. Bosses are immune.
spell.rites_and_paths.fugue.guide: You dash forward instantly (about 7 blocks, less if a wall is in the way) leaving a trail of notes: enemies you pass through are pushed back and stunned for half a second.
spell.rites_and_paths.grand_piano.guide: A shadow grows under your target and follows it; at the end it stops and a piano falls. Get out of the way!
spell.rites_and_paths.grand_solo.guide: You play a solo: for a few seconds your combo is at maximum and misses don't lose it, and the next spell you cast has no cooldown.
spell.rites_and_paths.harmony_barrier.gu: A dome of notes stays where you cast it: it absorbs enemy projectiles and reduces the damage you and your allies take inside it.
spell.rites_and_paths.info.absorb: Removes negative effects and gives %s absorption for %s s
spell.rites_and_paths.info.barrier: Absorbs projectiles and −%s%% damage taken for %s s
spell.rites_and_paths.info.choir: Three singers for %s s: %s damage per second near them
spell.rites_and_paths.info.echo: Repeats your last spell at %s%% power (up to %s s later)
spell.rites_and_paths.info.requiem: +%s%% damage for your allies for %s s
spell.rites_and_paths.info.second_piano: A second piano falls with half damage
spell.rites_and_paths.info.siren: Pulls enemies toward you for %s s
spell.rites_and_paths.info.solo: Combo at maximum with no loss for %s s; your next spell has no cooldown
spell.rites_and_paths.info.ward: Survive a lethal blow with %s%% health (%s s)
spell.rites_and_paths.iron_chorale.guide: Aura: you and your allies take less damage.
spell.rites_and_paths.lullaby.guide: A cone of soft singing in front of you: the normal enemies it reaches fall asleep. Any damage wakes them up. Bosses are immune and players sleep half as long.
spell.rites_and_paths.mana_cadence.guide: Aura: you and your allies regenerate mana faster.
spell.rites_and_paths.march.guide: Aura: you and your allies run and attack faster.
spell.rites_and_paths.phantom_choir.guid: Three spectral singers sing around you for a few seconds: nearby enemies stop chasing you and your allies and come to listen, and take sonic damage every second.
spell.rites_and_paths.resolution.guide: A chord that resolves the tension: you and your nearby allies lose every negative effect and gain an absorption shield for a few seconds.
spell.rites_and_paths.rest_ballad.guide: Aura: you and your allies regenerate health.
spell.rites_and_paths.rumble.guide: A cone of sound in front of you that damages and pushes back enemies.
spell.rites_and_paths.siren_song.guide: An irresistible song: nearby enemies are dragged toward you for a few seconds (bosses more slowly). Perfect for grouping them before a Rumble or a Dissonance.
spell.rites_and_paths.war_hymn.guide: Aura: you and your allies deal more damage.
subclass.rites_and_paths.agile_scout.des: Swift scout: more speed, triple jump and wall climbing.
subclass.rites_and_paths.angel.desc: Wings of light: less fall damage and slow fall, a halo that regenerates nearby allies and, from level 5, Angelic Form: you fly for a few seconds while you and your allies regenerate and are purified.
subclass.rites_and_paths.angel.name: Angel
subclass.rites_and_paths.arcane_blade.de: A Rogue who also casts spells: loses the Magic wall, gains mana and power, and their first spell from invisibility hits harder.
subclass.rites_and_paths.battle_mage.des: A front-line Mage who alternates sword and spell. Each spell imbues your weapon with its school (fire burns, ice slows, lightning jumps, blood heals, nature poisons, ender takes you behind the target, evocation raises fangs, eldritch releases a sonic wave in a line and water pushes); every 3 consecutive hits your next spell costs less mana. You aren't interrupted when casting, you lose the melee weapon walls and the mana you spend gives you a shield.
subclass.rites_and_paths.beast_master.de: Your bonded pets are stronger, faster and tougher, and escape death by returning to your spawn point, where they lose their non-permanent potion effects, are extinguished if burning and are invulnerable for 5 s. Bonds are made and broken only with the Book of Bonds.
subclass.rites_and_paths.blessed_guardia: Healing protector. You receive more healing and your Bulwark heals the group with the damage you mitigate.
subclass.rites_and_paths.breeze_master.d: The fastest and the highest jumper, with an aerial dash.
subclass.rites_and_paths.charging_jugger: A mountain of health. Your Bulwark becomes an unstoppable charge that tramples enemies.
subclass.rites_and_paths.chronomancer.de: Mage of time. You cast spells faster and master two abilities: Time Rewind, which takes you back to where you were a few seconds ago recovering health and mana, and Time Stop, a sphere that freezes enemies and projectiles for an instant.
subclass.rites_and_paths.elementalist.de: Your spells build charges on enemies; when full they detonate according to the school: fire explodes, ice freezes, lightning jumps in arcs, blood steals life, ender teleports, evocation raises fangs, nature roots and poisons, eldritch leaves the Mark of the Void (stores the damage it takes and then implodes), and water (with T.O Magic 'n Extras) launches a wave that pushes and soaks.
subclass.rites_and_paths.enchanter.desc: Master of control. Your control effects last longer, the dance spreads to nearby mobs and, from level 5, mobs that come out of the dance or Dissonance stay charmed and fight each other.
subclass.rites_and_paths.enchanter.name: Enchanter
subclass.rites_and_paths.heavy_palm.desc: Hits that knock back and reach farther. While crouching you charge the palm (more damage and knockback; at full charge it breaks guard). If the launched enemy crashes into a block or another enemy, it takes extra damage and is stunned and disabled.
subclass.rites_and_paths.heavy_palm.name: Heavy Palm
More health and the Gamble with Death: on a fatal hit a coin is flipped; on the ankh you survive (75% the first time, then 50%).
subclass.rites_and_paths.intercessor.des: Prays for an ally even without seeing them: your body stays kneeling and your sight moves to a small angel that accompanies them. You cast your spells from the angel, with less power the farther away your body is.
subclass.rites_and_paths.martyr.desc: Heals with their own blood: more health, less damage taken when badly hurt and, from level 5, Sacrifice: you pay health to heal an ally, with no cooldown. If you can no longer pay, you can give your life for them.
subclass.rites_and_paths.martyr.name: Martyr
subclass.rites_and_paths.minstrel.desc: The most versatile: more sheet music slots in your instruments, spells with a lower minimum combo and, from level 5, the Recital: after three different spells in a row, the next one is free and recharges sooner.
subclass.rites_and_paths.minstrel.name: Minstrel
subclass.rites_and_paths.plague_corrupto: Immune to hunger, poison and wither. Your hits spread the Plague, which damages over time even the undead.
subclass.rites_and_paths.shadow_illusion: Even harder to detect, and when you turn invisible you leave a decoy that distracts enemies.
subclass.rites_and_paths.shadow_walker.d: You move crouched as fast as walking and teleport short distances.
subclass.rites_and_paths.sniper.desc: Very fast arrows and much more damage per shot, in exchange for drawing the bow slower.
subclass.rites_and_paths.sniper.name: Sniper
subclass.rites_and_paths.suicidal_berser: More damage, and when you take a fatal hit you become immortal for a few seconds: if you kill your attacker, you live.
subclass.rites_and_paths.triworld_guardi: Each stance protects you from one type of damage and adds its own effect: fire, water or stone.
subclass.rites_and_paths.unyielding_bast: Immovable. Immune to knockback, you resist bursts of hits and your Bulwark cleanses you of negative effects.
subclass.rites_and_paths.war_chanter.des: A front-line Bard. Each note you hit adds damage with light and heavy weapons (on top of your walls), every fifth on-beat strike releases a sonic wave and, with high Harmony, you hit even harder.
When falling from high up you glide slowly and without damage; with ranks, from lower heights, with air control and a wing flap.
Nearby allies regenerate mana faster, you receive more healing from potions and spells, and your horn rams harder.
At 40% of your top speed or more you attack without slowing down (Epic Fight) and deal more melee damage the faster you go. Ramming slows you down less.
You carry a belt of chests, furnaces and tables that you can use while walking (race key 1; allies open it by sneaking and right-clicking you), and your allies can ride on you. Somewhat slower, and more so with passengers.
subrace.rites_and_paths.colossus.titan.d: Grow (racial key 1): you double your size again with a second health bar, break in 3×3×3 and the ground shakes with every step.
subrace.rites_and_paths.draconid.acid.de: You resist acid, food never disagrees with you and your breath corrodes the target's armor. Wild hydras do not attack you unless provoked.
subrace.rites_and_paths.draconid.fire.de: You resist fire and your breath sets enemies alight. Wild fire dragons do not attack you unless provoked.
subrace.rites_and_paths.draconid.ice.des: You resist ice and freezing, and your breath slows. Wild ice dragons do not attack you unless provoked.
subrace.rites_and_paths.draconid.lightni: You resist lightning and your breath's lightning jumps to nearby enemies. Wild lightning dragons do not attack you unless provoked.
You resist toxic damage (immune to Poison from Rank 2) and your breath poisons. Wild gorgons do not attack you unless provoked.
subrace.rites_and_paths.draconid.water.d: You resist water and drowning, your air lasts three times as long (you breathe underwater from Rank 2) and your breath pushes and puts out fire. Wild sea serpents do not attack you unless provoked.
subrace.rites_and_paths.dwarf.deep.desc: You see in the dark underground and are immune to Darkness. Stone Sense (racial key 1, Rank 1) highlights nearby ores and lava.
subrace.rites_and_paths.dwarf.deep.name: of the Depths
subrace.rites_and_paths.dwarf.demolisher: Your own TNT does not hurt you and explodes with a 25% larger radius. From Rank 1, breaking an ore also breaks the connected ones (not while crouching). At Rank 3, crouching, you mine stone in a 3×3 tunnel (uses more hunger).
subrace.rites_and_paths.dwarf.smith.desc: Things you craft or repair last longer (+20%, +40% at Rank 2). From Rank 1 the anvil costs you half the levels. At Rank 3 things you craft come out with Unbreaking +1 (maximum III).
subrace.rites_and_paths.dwarf.smith.name: Smith
subrace.rites_and_paths.elf.arcane.desc: The enchanting table counts as if its level were higher and enchanting (table or anvil) costs you less experience. At Rank 3, fuse two identical maximum-level enchantments at the anvil to exceed that maximum by 1.
subrace.rites_and_paths.elf.arcane.name: Arcane
subrace.rites_and_paths.elf.dark.desc: You see in any darkness. Smoke Cloud (racial key 1, Rank 1): you and your allies inside are invisible and mobs outside lose sight of you. It is not revealed by proximity.
subrace.rites_and_paths.elf.dark.name: Dark
subrace.rites_and_paths.elf.sylvan.desc: Your crops give more yield; with ranks, plant food fills you more and you can grow crops with an empty hand.
subrace.rites_and_paths.elf.sylvan.name: Sylvan
subrace.rites_and_paths.goblin.thief.des: Light Fingers: when hitting in melee you can steal an item from a mob's loot (without killing it) or from a player's inventory (never from the hotbar or the kit).
subrace.rites_and_paths.goblin.trapper.d: Snare (racial key 1): you place a trap that never expires, only you can see it and the first enemy to step on it takes damage and is immobilized.
subrace.rites_and_paths.goblin.wolf_ride: Right-click your wolf with an empty hand to ride it (crouching: make it sit, as usual). With ranks: your wolves have more health, the ridden wolf bites whatever you hit and regenerates while you ride it.
subrace.rites_and_paths.human.autodidact: You lose less XP when resetting your class or subclass: the loss is reduced by your Rank's percentage.
subrace.rites_and_paths.human.polyvalent: Choose a second wall, which receives half the reduction.
subrace.rites_and_paths.human.specialist: The reduction of your chosen wall is 50% greater (up to −75% at Rank 3).
Piglins, brutes and hoglins are neutral toward you unless you attack them. With ranks: immune to Wither, better bartering with piglins and Infernal Compass (racial key 1, Rank 3).
subrace.rites_and_paths.infernal.pyroman: Your racial Fire Shot pierces enemies. With ranks, your racial Magma Bomb leaves a pool of flames and, at Rank 3, lava that slows. Requires Iron's Spells.
subrace.rites_and_paths.infernal.smelter: You walk on lava. With ranks, nearby furnaces run faster, ores you mine come out smelted and you instantly smelt what you hold in hand (racial key 1, Rank 3).
subrace.rites_and_paths.orc.devourer.des: You eat raw meat and fish without negative effects and they fill you as if cooked. With ranks, killing feeds you and grants combat effects.
subrace.rites_and_paths.orc.stoneskin.de: Thick Skin: each hit you take deals less damage by a fixed amount, with no minimum.
subrace.rites_and_paths.orc.warlord.desc: Warlord's Voice (racial key 1): removes control effects from you and nearby allies.
subrace.rites_and_paths.orc.warlord.name: Warlord
subrace.rites_and_paths.slime.mitotic.de: Even less health, but when an enemy lands a lethal hit you split into two half-size copies. Sneak next to your copy to merge.
subrace.rites_and_paths.slime.spring.des: Sneak to charge a jump; when you jump you are launched where you look (like Riptide), with no impact damage and bouncing off floors and walls.
subrace.rites_and_paths.slime.swarm.desc: Racial key 1: you split into one small slime per heart (max 25) that only deal contact damage. Each hit kills one slime and the leftover damage does not carry over. Healing while split spawns new slimes. Press again to merge.
subrace.rites_and_paths.slime.swarm.name: Swarm
subrace.rites_and_paths.slime.viscous.de: Sneak against a wall or an entity to stick to it. You slide slowly down walls as if on honey and your hits apply Slowness.
subrace.rites_and_paths.triton.abyssal.d: Drowned and guardians are neutral toward you unless you attack them. With ranks: underwater immunities, camouflage and a guardian escort.
subrace.rites_and_paths.triton.fisher.de: Fish bite sooner and you have racial Luck of the Sea when fishing; with ranks, extra catches, more treasure and more experience.
subrace.rites_and_paths.triton.shaper.de: Racial water spells always in the Iron's wheel: Hydroshot; Overflow (level 3) at Rank 1; Jetstream at Rank 2 and Tidal Grasp at Rank 3. They cost mana and suffer your class's Magic wall. Requires T.O Magic 'n Extras.
Skeletons are neutral toward you unless you attack them and you take less projectile damage. At Rank 3 your regeneration is interrupted for less time.
subrace.rites_and_paths.undead.specter.d: You take no fall damage and fall slowly (crouching prevents it). Ethereal Form (racial key 1, Rank 1): a few seconds unable to take damage or attack; it does not protect from the sun.
subrace.rites_and_paths.undead.vampire.d: Thirst: killing heals you and, with ranks, you steal life from the damage you deal (with a per-second cap).
tooltip.rites_and_paths.creative_amulet: Testing: while it is in your inventory, every class and race cooldown is 0.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.instrument.how: Right click: casts the spell selected on Iron's wheel. Shift + right click (out of combat, in main hand): music stand. Sheet music can also be added at Iron's Inscription Table.
tooltip.rites_and_paths.instrument.passi: Your auras have 25% more radius, and Last Note deals double damage with 25% more radius.
Every 10 hits in a row releases a boom that stuns enemies within 4 blocks for 1 s (not bosses).
Every 10 hits in a row you recover 5% of your max mana.
Perfect hits heal 0.5 health to allies within 8 blocks and 0.25 to you (at most every half second).
Two-handed axe that can also be played. The Bard has no Heavy Weapons wall with it; other classes use it as a normal axe.
Your auras reduce fire damage by 25% for you and your allies.
Your auras reduce ice damage by 25% for you and your allies.
Your auras reduce lightning damage by 25% for you and your allies.
Misses cost you half as much combo as usual.
